messages:
Sam: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Maya: done: validated canary routing for ingress v2, caught a header normalization mismatch (fix in branch).
Maya: blocker: some users still hit the old policy due to cookie-based routing, need a tiny rollout tweak.
Sam: done: merged rate limit middleware change for per-route buckets (PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/482). Left a short note on token bucket sizing.
Sam: blocker: seeing a small uptick of 429s on dedicated pool when sequence length > 2k, probably batching fallout.
Tariq: fyi I reproduced the 429 locally with a stress script — looks like concurrent KV cache invalidation + long seqs.
Tariq: workaround: reducing max_batch_tokens to 1024 helps. Can we A/B that in canary?
Maya: yes, canary config patch ready. I'll wire the routing policy so traffic for canary uses proxy-pool-2 and reduced batch.
Jen: today: i'll review the middleware PR and the canary config, will check for auth token propagation to the proxy-pool.
Jen: note: left comments about missing forwarded-for header in the proxy pass — that can affect per-customer buckets.
Sam: thanks — @Jen can you also eyeball the healthcheck path? deploy-bot showed an intermittent 503 during the last rollout.
deploy-bot: deploy event: canary deploy started for ingress-v2 on pool proxy-pool-2 at 2025-06-12T14:22:00Z :rocket:
Maya: quick snippet of the canary override I'm pushing (rate/batching):
```yaml
route_overrides:
  - id: ingress-v2-canary
    batch:
      max_batch_tokens: 1024
    rate_limit:
      bucket_key: route+customer_id
      qps: 25
```
Tariq: sounds good — after canary let's run a small traffic replay to the canary routes (10k reqs with mixed seq lengths). I'll stand by for logs.
Sam: today I'm pairing with @Tariq on replay, and pinging infra to add a short-lived metric for per-batch-token-avg so we can see distribution.
Jen: will aim to finish CR by EOD. If anything blocks, I'll post here. :eyes:
Maya: rollout timeline: canary for 1h, if 429s drop by 60% and p99 latency stable -> promote.
ops-bot: alert muted for canary pool until 2025-06-12T15:30:00Z per request from Sam.
Sam: thanks team. small reminder — if you spot customer-affecting 429s, add a note to the thread with request ids (X-Req-ID) so we can correlate.
Maya: will do. :thumbsup:
